title: VersatileFFN: Achieving Parameter Efficiency in LLMs via Adaptive Wide-and-Deep Reuse
reasoning: The paper focuses on the architectural design of a parameter-efficient feed-forward network for Large Language Models. Its evaluation is limited to standard linguistic and reasoning performance benchmarks (e.g., PIQA, ARC, HellaSwag) and does not contain any components related to religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
